purpose: One/Zero interpretations bound to the corrected Tax Year 2024 eligibility floor while preserving workbook evidence gates.
source_basis: Georgia JTC Step 1 Avg Wages and Hours Narrative
Georgia JTC Step 1 Avg Wages and Hours Diagram
GA JTC One Zero Methodology Overview.xlsx (SHA-256 C2F8CF527AF8423F88105D3EE77B30F938D7CFCE4E5D532A6C851F60701D310A)

OZ-01.decision: Generate twelve One/Zero month targets from the approved Reference fiscal window, August 2023 through July 2024. Do not use the workbook's malformed hard-coded cutoff dates as expected values.
OZ-01.falsified_by: John's Access run uses another twelve-month matrix window.

OZ-02.decision: Min-Max coverage uses earliest included PPS through latest included PPE per employee, unit, and FEIN; assign 1 when Min PPS <= monthly cutoff <= Max PPE.
OZ-02.falsified_by: John's Access matrix uses paycheck dates or another coverage range.

OZ-03.decision: Pay Period coverage uses PPS <= month target <= PPE. The original equality-to-paycheck-date wording remains treated as a defect because the workbook does not resolve that conflict.
OZ-03.falsified_by: John confirms equality-to-paycheck-date or another coverage rule.

OZ-04.decision: For Month 12, when the employee's last PPE is in Month 12 and day > 15, use that PPE as the target; otherwise use month end. The workbook's December 27 cutoff supports this special case but is not a universal date.
OZ-04.falsified_by: A later John-authored flow supersedes the Month-12 rule.

OZ-05.decision: Pay Period One/Zero uses reviewed company pay-cycle groups or practitioner-identified material payroll dates. The median-employee-participation heuristic may be shown as a diagnostic proposal but cannot support parity or sign-off.
OZ-05.falsified_by: John supplies a deterministic classifier that is validated against Access period output.

OZ-06.decision: No employee may contribute more than one count in a month. Flag every overlap before correction. V3 retains the latest-PPS/latest-PPE/stable-order disposition only as a reproducible provisional view; sign-off requires a reviewed disposition because the workbook does not define the winning unit.
OZ-06.falsified_by: John supplies an authoritative automatic allocation rule or reviewed manual dispositions.

OZ-07.decision: For this full-year benchmark, divide unit total by 12. Preserve unrounded, source-nearest-whole half-up, and application two-decimal views separately.
OZ-07.falsified_by: John uses a partial-year denominator, another rounding sequence, or only one output precision.

OZ-08.decision: Eligibility remains customer-wide; One/Zero matrix grain includes employee, unit, and FEIN. Unit determines legal entity for this source unless an exception is flagged.
OZ-08.falsified_by: John's Access output uses another legal-entity allocation grain.

OZ-09.decision: Min-Max emits one row per eligible employee-unit-FEIN span. Pay Period first collapses pay lines sharing employee/unit/FEIN/PPS/PPE, then emits one row per reviewed major period.
OZ-09.falsified_by: John's Access matrix uses another row grain.

change_control.supersession_rule: Create a new versioned file when John or Access evidence resolves an ambiguity; retain this v3 with all runs that used it.
